result.summary: No critical blockers are visible, but the bottom navigation appears inconsistent: the Orders tab label is shown without a matching icon. A few carousel items are also clipped at the right edge, which looks partly intentional but may read as truncation.

issues.description: The bottom navigation Orders item shows only the text label and no icon, while Home, Search, and Profile all have icons.
issues.suggestion: Add or restore the Orders icon so all bottom navigation items have consistent icon-plus-label alignment.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and the third Fastest near you card are cut off at the screen edge, with the restaurant name truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol...'.
issues.suggestion: If this is a horizontal carousel, add clearer scroll affordance or padding; otherwise reduce card width so content is not ambiguously clipped.

issues.description: Search placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a pale gray field and may be low contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text or increase field contrast to meet WCAG contrast guidance.
